teachers.Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the supports.Monitor students’ progress and well-being.Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.Participate *OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.   Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.   Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.   Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. In this highly autonomous role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations. Lead end-to-end scoping, including framing business questions, defining hypotheses, and recommending appropriate methodologies. Act as the primary analytics interface in Brazil, effectively collaborating with non-technical stakeholders and building strong, trusted relationships. Provide consultative guidance throughout the project lifecycle, from early-stage solutioning through final delivery and interpretation. Serve as a lead analytics practitioner, independently designing and executing advanced quantitative methodologies, including segmentation, brand tracking, pricing and elasticity modeling, conjoint and MaxDiff, ad and concept testing, claims substantiation, driver analysis, media mix modeling, and attribution. Own the end-to-end delivery of analytical projects, ensuring methodological rigor, quality, and business relevance. Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights, with strong storytelling tailored to senior stakeholders by clearly explaining the mechanics behind models and analytical approaches, ensuring transparency and stakeholder confidence in results. Design and develop AI-enabled analytics solutions (e.g., analytical agents, automated insight generation, decision support tools) leveraging LLMs or similar technologies. Identify opportunities where AI can enhance productivity and insight quality across data preparation, modeling, validation, and reporting. Partner with engineering, product, and analytics teams to operationalize solutions at scale, ensuring repeatability and efficiency. Champion automation and standardization, reducing manual effort and improving consistency across engagements. Support the development and adoption of AI governance practices, including responsible use guidelines, bias detection and mitigation, and documentation standards. Ensure all analytical and AI-driven outputs maintain high standards of quality, transparency, and ethical integrity. Balance innovation with rigor, ensuring new approaches are credible, defensible, and client-ready.  Your profile:  5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles, ideally in a client-facing or consulting environment. Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related quantitative field. Proven ability to lead analytical projects end-to-end, from scoping and problem framing through delivery, including stakeholder management and quality control. Demonstrated ability to work closely with non-technical stakeholders (e.g., research, sales, clients), translating business needs into analytical solutions. Fluency in English is required; additional languages (particularly Portuguese/Spanish) are a strong plus.  **Please submit your CV in English  Our Values:  A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring What we offer:  At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board. Other Benefits:  Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal vouchers, transportation vouchers, and language class subsidy. Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: AI Operations Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando AI Operations Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Our Client  Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain.  Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role  We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer  to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought \"this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\" this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence  Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic \"growing your trucking business\" pitch Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack  Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence  Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems)  Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics  Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings  Field & Event Activation  Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works  Internal AI Tooling  Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering  What We're Looking For Required  3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL; comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time  Strongly Preferred  Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration  You'll thrive here if you  Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing; You'd rather ship a v1 in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers; their adoption of what you build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes  What Success Looks Like By 90 days:  Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team; outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months:  Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months:  PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

title: Promo Team Lead - Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Promo Team Lead - Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Pocket FM  Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead  to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market. As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series. The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks. Key Responsibilities  1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction  Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners. Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery. Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals. Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.  2. Promo Creation & Localization  Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series. Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese. Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences. Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.  3. Production & Quality Control  Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery. Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output. Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives. Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.  4. Dubbing Agency Management  Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production. Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery. Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit. Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.  5. Performance Reworks & Optimization  Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues. Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance. Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals. Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles. Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.  6. Process, Tracking & Reporting  Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered. Track ownership, status, timelines, delays, feedback, and final delivery for each asset. Share weekly progress reports with the India team and relevant stakeholders. Create SOPs, checklists, and workflows to avoid leakages across the production process.  7. AI Tool Adoption  Use GenAI tools for ad writing, ideation, VO production, image creation, video creation, and workflow improvement. Guide the team in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, and efficiency. Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows for promo production. Ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed for storytelling quality, cultural accuracy, and production readiness.  8. Market & Audience Understanding  Apply strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption habits, and market trends. Ensure promos feel native, relevant, and compelling for Brazilian audiences. Stay updated on digital ads, audio entertainment, trailer formats, and performance creative trends.  Qualifications  Degree in Filmmaking, Marketing, Advertising, Media, Communications, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in ad creation, promo creation, trailer development, marketing creatives, ad copywriting, or performance creative production. Strong understanding of marketing, ad storytelling, promo creation, and audience engagement. Experience leading creative or production teams, including writers, editors, sound engineers, or external vendors. Excellent command of English and Brazilian Portuguese. Strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption patterns, and cultural nuances. Experience working with dubbing agencies, VO artists, production teams, or post-production vendors. Skilled in GenAI tools for writing, VO production, image creation, video creation, and creative workflow improvement. Ability to create SOPs, trackers, review systems, and scalable creative processes. Strong analytical ability to review ad performance and convert insights into actionable creative reworks. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Strategic thinker with strong ownership and business growth orientation. Understanding of performance marketing on Meta and UAC is a plus.  Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is a creative leader who understands storytelling, promo production, and performance-driven advertising. They should be able to lead a multi-functional team, manage dubbing partners, maintain strong quality control, and deliver high-quality promo assets at scale. They should have strong knowledge of Brazilian audiences, excellent creative judgment, hands-on production understanding, and the ability to turn performance feedback into clear creative action. Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ 7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

 Profile:  Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:  TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; title: Project Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Project Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology. This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 CreativeTen16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.  About the RoleThe Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. QualificationsThe ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando GTM Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Our Client  Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain.  Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role  We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer  to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought \"this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\" this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence  Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic \"growing your trucking business\" pitch Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack  Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence  Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems)  Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics  Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings  Field & Event Activation  Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works  Internal AI Tooling  Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering  What We're Looking For Required  3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL; comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time  Strongly Preferred  Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration  You'll thrive here if you  Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing; You'd rather ship a v1 in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers; their adoption of what you build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes  What Success Looks Like By 90 days:  Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team; outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months:  Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months:  PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:

About Turing:  Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview:  We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:  You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:  Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)  Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.  Offer Details:  Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :  Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles  Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Airbus A320 Pic Captain – Abu Dhabi Relocation

Job DescriptionMake the world your home.It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.What we offerEtihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589) per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits:Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three childrenIncome protection scheme42 days of annual leaveIndustry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discountsEnd-of-service benefitsAccidental and life insurance coverageEtihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the worldThe RoleAs a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all timesExercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdownLead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource managementOperate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policiesDeliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfactionWhat you'll bringTo be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time.A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 FamilyFlown A320 family within the last 12 monthsType rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joiningUnrestricted and current ICAO ATPLCurrent on A320Unrestricted and current Class 1 medicalHave not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joiningCurrent TRE/TRI is an advantageEnglish Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higherIn case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum(1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDSAdditional InformationEtihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our "Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.To learn more visit  Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

WANTED: Consultora comercial que sabe que lead quente não espera. E que não vai deixar nenhum escapar. Eles viram os resultados no Instagram. Já querem fazer o procedimento. Já estão imaginando como vão ficar. Já pesquisaram sobre harmonização. O trabalho pesado de gerar desejo? O Instagram já fez. Você não vai precisar criar desejo do zero - as fotos e vídeos criam. Você não vai precisar explicar por que vale a pena - as pacientes satisfeitas mostram. O que você vai precisar fazer é simples e poderoso: responder rápido, entender o momento da cliente, tirar as dúvidas certas, e não deixar ela escapar enquanto \"pensa\". A clínica entrega o resultado. O Instagram entrega o lead. Você entrega a consulta paga. É uma máquina. E você é a peça que faz ela funcionar. Sem você, lead vira só número no direct. Com você, lead vira paciente na agenda, faturamento no caixa, transformação na vida de uma mulher. SOBRE A CLÍNICA Somos uma clínica de harmonização facial que transforma a autoestima de mulheres todos os dias. Nosso Instagram gera interesse. Nossos procedimentos geram resultado. Nossas pacientes geram indicações. A demanda existe. O desejo existe. A confiança existe. O que falta é você conectando tudo isso em consultas pagas. VOCÊ É... O tipo de pessoa que vê uma notificação no direct e já sente a adrenalina de uma possível conversão. Que entende que velocidade é conversão - e age de acordo. Que não manda preço e espera. Manda preço e já prepara o próximo passo. Que trata \"vou pensar\" como o início da venda, não como o fim. Que sente satisfação real quando transforma uma conversa difícil em agendamento confirmado. É quase como se uma closer, uma estrategista e uma organizadora obsessiva tivessem uma filha. Você tem fome de resultado. E a estrutura pra sustentar isso. SUA MISSÃO Transformar seguidores em leads. Transformar leads em consultas pagas. Transformar consultas em pacientes recorrentes. Seu trabalho é não deixar ninguém escapar do funil. ..mas antes que você fique toda empolgada, vou te interromper aqui... Porque essa função não é fácil. Ok? Exige velocidade. Exige organização. Exige resiliência. E exige uma capacidade rara de manter o ritmo intenso dia após dia. A carga é pesada. O ritmo é acelerado. E a gente só quer quem aguenta o tranco. NA PRÁTICA, VOCÊ VAI: ● Monitorar o Instagram como um radar: Comentários, DMs, reações, menções. Onde tem interação, tem oportunidade. Você não espera aparecer - você vai buscar. ● Abordar rápido e trazer pro WhatsApp: A rede social é vitrine. O WhatsApp é onde você controla a conversa. Você faz essa ponte em minutos, não em horas. ● Qualificar a necessidade: Entender o que ela quer, qual o momento dela, quais as dúvidas reais. Não é só \"passar informação\" - é descobrir como ajudar ela a decidir. ● Conduzir com estratégia até a consulta PAGA: Você não agenda. Você FECHA. O ciclo só termina quando tem pagamento. ● Confirmar as consultas agendadas: Ligação, mensagem, lembrete. O que for preciso pra garantir que ela apareça. No-show é zero no caixa. ● Follow-up como rotina sagrada: 	○ Lead que perguntou e sumiu? Volta nele. 	○ Lead que disse \"tá caro\"? Entende a objeção real. 	○ Lead que disse \"vou pensar\"? Mantém o relacionamento até ela decidir. 	○ Paciente que cancelou? Reagenda. 	○ Paciente que fez há 6 meses? Hora da manutenção. ● Trabalhar a base de pacientes existentes: Quem já fez uma vez, volta. Quem gostou, indica. Sua função é ativar isso. Todo dia. ● Manter o CRM organizado em tempo real: Status atualizado, próximo passo definido, histórico completo. Você precisa saber exatamente onde cada lead está no funil. SEUS INDICADORES DE SUCESSO O QUE MUDA NO SEU DIA A DIA Urgência é regra. Seguidor que comentou AGORA precisa ser atendido AGORA. Não daqui a pouco. Não quando der. AGORA. Lead quente esfria em minutos. A concorrente responde em segundos. Velocidade é conversão. O objetivo é consulta PAGA. Vamos deixar claro: agendar não é o objetivo. Faturar é. Consulta marcada que não acontece é zero no caixa. Consulta marcada que não paga é prejuízo de tempo. O ciclo só fecha quando a consulta é paga e realizada. Base de pacientes é ouro. Sabe aquela planilha de pacientes antigos que ninguém mexe? Isso é dinheiro parado. Cada nome ali é uma mulher que já confiou na clínica, já viu resultado, já tem relacionamento. Reativar a base é mais fácil que conquistar lead novo. E você vai fazer isso todo dia. Follow-up é onde o dinheiro está. A maioria das secretárias manda preço e espera. Você não. Você entende que \"vou pensar\" não é não - é \"me convença\". Você sabe que quem sumiu depois do orçamento só precisa do lembrete certo no momento certo. Seu follow-up é o que separa agenda vazia de agenda lotada. NÃO É PRA VOCÊ SE: ● Acha follow-up \"chato\" ou \"insistente demais\" ● Manda preço e espera a cliente decidir sozinha ● Tem vergonha de puxar a conversa pra venda ● Acha que responder \"quando der\" é aceitável ● Desaparece no horário de almoço quando os leads estão pipocando ● Vê atendimento como tarefa, não como oportunidade de fechar ● Precisa que alguém fique cobrando pra você fazer follow-up É PRA VOCÊ SE: ● Entende que cada lead ignorado é dinheiro perdido ● Sente satisfação real quando converte uma conversa difícil ● Faz follow-up naturalmente - não precisa de lembrete ● Age como se cada lead fosse dinheiro do seu bolso ● Tem organização: não deixa nada cair no esquecimento ● Gosta de ritmo intenso e resultado visível ● Entende que vender bem é atender bem A CANDIDATA DOS SONHOS TEM: Velocidade: Você não deixa lead esfriar. Chegou, você responde. Ponto. Fome de resultado: Você quer converter. Quer bater meta. Quer ver o número subir. Resiliência: \"Vou pensar\" não te desanima. Te dá mais vontade de fazer o follow-up certo. Organização obsessiva: CRM atualizado, follow-ups no dia certo, zero lead esquecido. Sem precisar de cobrança. Ownership: Você trata cada lead como se fosse dinheiro do seu bolso. Porque, com comissão, é. Ritmo: Você aguenta carga intensa. E gosta disso. A MELHOR PARTE ● Remuneração competitiva: Fixo + comissão por resultado. Quanto mais você converte, mais você ganha. ● Crescimento direto: Seu salário cresce junto com sua performance. Sem teto. ● Ambiente meritocrático: Aqui vale quem gera número, não aparência de trabalho. ● Autonomia total: Liberdade pra conduzir suas conversas e criar suas estratégias.  ● Feedback claro: Você sabe exatamente se está performando ou não. Sem subjetividade. ● Treinamento: Você não vai ser jogada no fogo. Vai aprender o método que funciona. ● Impacto real: Cada consulta que você agenda muda a autoestima de uma mulher. Se você leu até aqui e pensou \"parece muito trabalho\"... não é pra você. E tá tudo bem. Se pensou \"finalmente uma vaga que paga por resultado de verdade\"... você é exatamente quem procuramos. Nos movemos em ritmo acelerado. Apenas candidatas que se destacarem serão contatadas. Se você não receber contato em 5 dias úteis, infelizmente não foi dessa vez. description:

Stell dir vor, du arbeitest von einem Coworking-Space auf Mallorca. Blauer Himmel, Meer, und du buchst gerade den nächsten Termin für dein Team. Das ist kein Urlaub. Das ist dein Job. Was hinter dieser Stelle steckt  Harucon Ventures skaliert E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Markt mit Google Ads auf ein neues Level. Wir sind kein 08/15-Arbeitgeber, wir bauen ein Team, das remote arbeitet, aber trotzdem zusammen ist.  Und wir haben entschieden, dass \"zusammen\" auch bedeutet: einmal im Jahr gemeinsam an einem der schönsten Orte Europas. Dieses Jahr? Mallorca. Nächstes Jahr? Portugal. Immer anders. Immer unvergesslich. Deine Rolle  Du bist der erste Kontakt zu potenziellen Kunden. Über LinkedIn und Social Media baust du echte Gespräche auf, qualifizierst Interessenten und buchst Ersttermine für unser Closing-Team. Kein Cold Calling. Reines Chat-Outreach, mit Skripten und Prozessen, die funktionieren. Du musst nichts erfinden. Du kriegst alles an die Hand, was du brauchst, und wirst von Anfang an eng begleitet. Was du mitbringst  Deutsch auf höchstem Niveau, schriftlich wie mündlich (C2 oder vergleichbar), da unser gesamter Markt DACH ist und jede Nachricht perfekt klingen muss Du bist auf LinkedIn und Social Media zuhause und weißt, wie man dort echte Gespräche führt Verlässlichkeit und Eigenverantwortung Sales-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Einstellungskriterium  Was du bekommst  Hier verdienst du solide, von Tag eins. Kein \"lass uns erstmal schauen\", kein Vertrösten. Du kennst dein Fixgehalt, bevor du auch nur eine Nachricht schreibst, und es liegt deutlich über dem Marktdurchschnitt. Dazu kommt ein Bonus für jeden gebuchten Termin. Dein Einsatz bestimmt direkt, was am Monatsende auf dem Konto landet. Und weil wir keine Stunden zählen, sondern Ergebnisse: Wer liefert, hat bei uns maximale Freiheit. Kein Micro-Management, keine Kontrolle, keine Rechtfertigungen. Du bist erwachsen, wir behandeln dich so. Außerdem:  100 % remote, du arbeitest wo und wann du willst Jährliches Team-Coworking auf Mallorca und Portugal, abwechselnd, alle Kosten übernommen Alle Tools, Skripte und Prozesse werden dir gestellt, du startest nicht bei null Schnelles Onboarding, enge Begleitung, kein Micro-Management Ein ambitioniertes Team, das sich gegenseitig weiterbringt Klare Entwicklungsperspektive, wer hier gut ist, wächst mit uns  Wie du dich bewirbst  Kein Lebenslauf, keine lange Bewerbung. Schick uns einfach eine kurze Nachricht direkt hier über LinkedIn und erzähl uns in zwei, drei Sätzen, wer du bist und warum dich diese Stelle reizt. Wir melden uns schnell.

title: Client Services Assistant
description:

Client Services Assistant Remote, Latin America Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together. We’re hiring a Client Services Assistant  to become a true backbone for our team. This is not a “wait for instructions” role. It’s for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover. You’ll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real. If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what’s missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit. What You’ll Own ----------- Client Services Operations  This is the center of the role. You’ll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, HubSpot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems. You’ll also help catch what’s slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared. The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled. Pipeline + Relationship Tracking You’ll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs. You won’t be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You’ll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client. Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination You’ll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar. That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full. You won’t own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management. This Role Is a Fit If You: • Notice gaps and communicate them early • Take ownership without needing to be chased • Track details carefully and follow through completely • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer • Can support a busy team without adding noise • Stay calm when priorities shift • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful This Role Is Not a Fit If You: • Need detailed instructions for every task • Wait to be told what to do next • See problems but don’t speak up • Think “done” means “mostly handled” • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented Requirements • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills • Clear written and verbal English • High ownership and follow-through • Strong attention to detail • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern SaaS systems • Fast, stable internet connection • Professional presence on video Tools may include ClickUp, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools. Work Setup Remote, Latin America preferred Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours) How to Apply We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through. If shortlisted, we will ask that you submit: • Your resume  • A short video introducing yourself  and telling us why this role speaks to you • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work We will follow up with a final list of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes. We’re looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks. If you’re the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Contract Type:  Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:  6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role  We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn  to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities  Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact  Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight  Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement  Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance  Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation  Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.  Required Qualifications & Experience  Technical & Operational Expertise  Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.  Revenue & Churn Acumen  Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.  Leadership & Stakeholder Management  Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.   Why This Role Matters  Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

We offer healthcare coverage to ensure you’re supported both personally and professionally.   We value collaboration, integrity, accountability, and a strong client-first mindset, while always finding ways to get great work done.  ⏰ Recruitment Process   Application: Submit your application via LinkedIn.  Initial Screening: Our team will review your profile to assess fit and experience.  Phone Interview: A short introductory call to understand your motivation and answer initial questions.  Technical Assessment: You'll complete a practical task or case study.  Final Interview: Meet with senior team members for a deeper conversation about the role and your potential fit.  Offer: If it's a match, you'll receive a formal offer to join our team!

Job Title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil) Position Type:  Full-Time or Part-Time Contract Location:  Remote (Must be based in Brazil) Reports To:  CEO / Founder Language Requirement:  Bilingual (Fluent English and Portuguese) Position Summary: We are a growing digital business with an established US LLC  and a expanding presence in Brazil  (including a physical office in São Paulo and a localized sales team). We are seeking a highly skilled International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist  to manage the day-to-day accounting, billing, and operational cash flow for both entities. In this dual-entity role, you will be the bridge between our US financial ecosystem and our local Brazilian operations. You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized. Key Responsibilities: 1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations:  Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks Online and local Brazilian platforms like Conta Azul / Agilize). Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations. Track intercompany transactions  (capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office).  2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR):  Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners. Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices (Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e) where applicable. Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese.  3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements:  Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors. Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports. Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure).  4. Data Integrity & Reporting:  Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity. Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership.  Required Qualifications & Skills: Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory):  3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices. Language Fluency:  Flawless written and spoken English  (for US vendors/clients) and Portuguese  (for local operations, banks, and agencies). Technical Proficiency:  Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (QuickBooks, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets. Localization Knowledge:  Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais, basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks.  What We Offer: 100% remote working environment with flexibility. Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion. Competitive compensation.

This role is for a designer who thrives in a long-term client relationship — someone who can lead UX strategy conversations, build wireframes, design polished deliverables, and present work directly to highly involved stakeholders. You’ll work closely with project managers, developers, and junior designers to bring cohesive web experiences to life, while serving as the primary design voice on the account. Strong UX thinking and time management are essential — you’ll be expected to self-direct and keep work moving with minimal oversight. Key Responsibilities  ● Own the creative and design process. ● Lead the design process from concept to completion, ensuring all deliverables meet high-quality standards and align with client goals. ● Lead UX and content strategy for a dedicated optimization client, translating goals into clear design direction. ● Collaborate with clients to understand their brand identity, target audience, and business objectives in order to create customized website designs that resonate with their audience. ● Build wireframes and design polished, conversion-focused web experiences from strategy through execution. ● Develop wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to effectively communicate design concepts and user interactions. ● Create and design visual systems and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites. ● Create visually appealing graphics, icons, and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites. ● Present creative work and strategic rationale directly to clients, navigating feedback with patience and professionalism. ● Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to continually improve the quality and innovation of our web designs. ● Direct junior designers as needed, providing clear briefs and feedback to maintain quality. ● Mentor and provide guidance to junior designers, fostering their growth and development within the team. ● Collaborate with developers for seamless Webflow handoff and execution. ● Work closely with the development team to ensure seamless integration of design elements and functionality. ● Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to iterate and refine designs for optimal user experience. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project timelines and milestones are met effectively. ● Proactively surface opportunities to improve the client’s digital experience. Qualifications  ● Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, or a related field. ● 5–7 years of web design experience, ideally with B2B or SaaS brands. ● Minimum of 5 years of experience in web design, with a strong portfolio showcasing a range of successful projects. ● Strong UX foundation: wireframing, information architecture, and user flow thinking — not just visual execution. ● Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), Sketch, or Figma. ● High proficiency in Figma required. ● Solid understanding of responsive design principles and best practices for web usability and accessibility. ● Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/jQuery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with developers. ● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present and explain design concepts to clients and team members. ● Proven experience presenting work and leading client conversations, especially with opinionated stakeholders. ● Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines. ● Collaborative, ego-free mindset with the patience to manage evolving feedback without losing momentum. ● Strong time management and the ability to self-direct within a long-term account structure. ● Experience with content management systems (CMS) such as Webflow. ● Portfolio showing both strategic thinking and visual craft, end-to-end. ● Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment. ● A passion for creativity, innovation, and staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies. Join our dynamic team and help us create exceptional web experiences that drive success for our clients! If you’re passionate about design, technology, and making a real impact, we want to hear from you.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:-  Administrar e desenvolver contas estratégicas, com atuação próxima aos clientes da carteira regional, buscando relacionamento de longo prazo e expansão de negócios; -  Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios por meio de mapeamento de mercado, levantamento de demandas, análise do potencial das contas e prospecção estruturada; -  Atuar de forma consultiva junto a laboratórios clínicos, compreendendo suas rotinas, necessidades operacionais e desafios, para propor soluções aderentes ao portfólio da empresa; -  Analisar concorrência, tendências e condições de mercado, gerando inteligência comercial para apoiar o posicionamento dos produtos e a tomada de decisão; -  Aumentar marketshare nas contas existentes, promovendo expansão de portfólio, fidelização de clientes e desenvolvimento de novas frentes comerciais; -  Cumprir agenda de visitas, rotas e demandas comerciais dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, com atuação externa frequente na região designada.Requisitos:-  Graduação completa; -  Vivência no segmento de diagnóstico clínico IVD, preferencialmente com relacionamento junto a laboratórios clínicos; -  Experiência em gestão de contas, prospecção e desenvolvimento de negócios; -  Conhecimento emanálise de mercado, concorrência e planejamento comercial; -  Habilidade paranegociação, relacionamento com clientes e condução de vendas consultivas; -  Vivência com contas estratégicas e expansão regional de mercado; -  Familiaridade com CRM, gestão de funil e indicadores comerciais.

title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Arquiteto de soluções sênior em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Descrição da vaga  A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização. Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:  ➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio. ➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor. ➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.). ➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um. ➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas. Arquitetura e Design da Solução:  ➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade. ➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência). ➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade. ➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc). ➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades. ➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc). ➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas. ➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras. ➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.). ➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.  Documentação e Apresentação:  ➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa. ➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados. ➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme). ➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução. ➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo. ➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.  Implementação e Operação:  ➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução. ➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente. ➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.  Requisitos Diferenciais:  ➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição). ➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração. ➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução. ➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados. ➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas. ➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência: ➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos. ➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas. ➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.  Conhecimentos Técnicos:  ➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.). ➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços. ➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.). ➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML). ➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia). ➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas. ➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git). ➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.  Habilidades : ➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. ➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas. ➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas. ➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada. ➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.  Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis:  ➢ Proatividade ➢ Pensamento analítico ➢ Orientação a resultados ➢ Colaboração ➢ Adaptabilidade ➢ Aprendizado contínuo

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. O que esperar de nós  Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!
